reasoning: This is a centralized CI/CD configuration repository for managing Konflux/Tekton build pipelines across all RHOAI components. It contains: (1) shared Tekton Pipeline definitions in pipelines/ (container-build, multi-arch-container-build, helm-chart-build, fbc-fragment-build); (2) per-component PipelineRun configurations in pipelineruns/ that are automatically synchronized to each component repository's .tekton/ directory; (3) a multi-arch-report.yaml tracking per-component architecture support status; (4) a trivial canary-build Go program that only prints 'canary build ok' for build health checks; and (5) validation tooling (pytest-based) for checking PipelineRun YAML correctness. There is no application logic, no operator controllers, no libraries, and no services — the sole purpose is to centrally manage CI/CD pipeline configuration that gets distributed to downstream component repos.
